title: Sell one orange house when mortgages are insufficient
description: Sell one orange house when mortgages are insufficient. Mortgage value is insufficient; sell evenly and keep the monopoly alive. The key distinction is whether a non-core mortgage, building sale, or bankruptcy is actually sufficient in this debt state.

final_action.public_message: I will mortgage my Electric Company to raise cash.
final_action.private_thought: Need cash to pay 280 rent. Mortgage ELECTRIC_COMPANY for $75, preserving houses on orange monopoly for future rent. This reduces utility income but is less damaging than selling houses now.
